source.title: WCA Regulations - April 2016
source.content:
A new version of the Regulations and Guidelines is going into effect April 18th, 2016.

The current Regulations are always available from [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) 

For an exact list of all changes from 2015 to 2016, [view the differences on GitHub](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/compare/official-2015-07-01...draft#files_bucket).

Summary of changes:

* The penalty for putting the puzzle outside the mat after the inspection phase and before starting the timer was defined as +2. ([#343](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/343) | [347](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/347))

* Scramble sequences should be used in a maximum time frame of 2 hours. ([#295](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/295) | [342](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/342/files))

* It has been clarified that cumulative time limits can be defined for a combination of events. ([#296](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/296) | [334](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/334))

* Generation 4 Pro Timers may be used for time measurement. (no issue | [333](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/333))

* Clock pins must not be identifiable from any other pin on the same side and the solved state of Clock is not affected by pin caps missing after the solve.  ([#189](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/189) |    [329](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/329/files))

* It was explicitly clarified that judges in Fewest Moves are allowed to compete. ([#165](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/165) | [329](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/329/files))

* It was clarified that every part of the body may be used during solves (except in Feet and One-Handed Solving). ([#300](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/300) |  [324](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/324/files))

* The minimum size of a mat was defined as 30 cm (left to right) by 25 cm (front to back).  ([#304](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/304) | [335](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/335/files))

* It is now recommended that extra attempts should be done right after the attempt they replace. (no issue | [341](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/341/files))

* The maximum number of rounds in an event is now defined by the number of competitors in every round (instead of the number of competitors in the event). ([#314](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/314) |   [346](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/346/files))

* All types of stickers are allowed in Fewest Moves (the word "coloured" was removed). ([#68](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/68) |  [329](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/329/files))

* The tab used for alignment of the layers in Square-1 may be removed during the attempt if the competitor forgot to remove it in the inspection phase.    ([#315](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/315) | [323](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/323/files))

* It has been clarified that the number of competitors may be limited per competition and not only per event. ([#311](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/311) and [#325](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/325) |  [#327](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/327/files))

* A clarification for Fewest Moves solutions that are similar to the inverse of the scramble sequence has been added. ([#344](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/344) | [348](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/348/files))

* In case of a cumulative time limit, the result of each remaining attempt in the round is recorded as DNS after a competitor reaches the time limit. ([#303](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/303) | [353](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/353/files))

translation.title: WCA 规则更新：2016 年 4 月
translation.content:
新版规则与指南将于 2016 年 4 月 18 日生效。

现行规则始终可从 [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) 获取。

2015 年版至 2016 年版的完整改动，请[在 GitHub 上查看差异](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/compare/official-2015-07-01...draft#files_bucket)。

主要改动如下：

* 明确观察结束后、启动计时器前将魔方放在垫子之外的处罚为加 2 秒。（[#343](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/343) | [347](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/347)）
* 同一打乱序列应在最长 2 小时的时间范围内使用。（[#295](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/295) | [342](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/342/files)）
* 明确可以为多个项目合并设置累计时限。（[#296](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/296) | [334](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/334)）
* 允许使用第四代 Pro 计时器计时。（无对应 issue | [333](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/333)）
* 魔表同一侧的各按针必须不可区分；还原后按针帽缺失不影响魔表是否已还原的判定。（[#189](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/189) | [329](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/329/files)）
* 明确最少步项目的裁判也可以参赛。（[#165](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/165) | [329](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/329/files)）
* 明确还原时可以使用身体的任何部位，脚拧和单手项目除外。（[#300](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/300) | [324](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/324/files)）
* 垫子的最小尺寸规定为左右 30 厘米、前后 25 厘米。（[#304](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/304) | [335](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/335/files)）
* 建议额外还原紧接在被替换的那次还原之后进行。（无对应 issue | [341](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/341/files)）
* 一个项目可安排的最大轮数，现在根据每一轮的选手人数确定，而不再根据整个项目的选手人数确定。（[#314](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/314) | [346](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/346/files)）
* 最少步项目允许所有类型的贴纸，删除了“有色”这一限制。（[#68](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/68) | [329](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/329/files)）
* 如果选手观察时忘记取下 Square-1 用于对齐层的卡片，可以在还原过程中将其取下。（[#315](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/315) | [323](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/323/files)）
* 明确可以为整场比赛设置人数上限，而不只是为单个项目设置。（[#311](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/311) 和 [#325](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/325) | [#327](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/327/files)）
* 补充说明如何处理与打乱逆序相似的最少步解法。（[#344](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/344) | [348](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/348/files)）
* 采用累计时限时，选手一旦达到时限，该轮剩余各次还原均记为 DNS。（[#303](https://github.com/cubing/wca-documents/issues/303) | [353](https://github.com/cubing/wca-regulations/pull/353/files)）
